column1: # 1D --min-gain sweep at the current compiled defaults (slope=425, floor=80,
# inject=8). --min-gain snaps |flip_gain| < min_gain/1000 to 0, so noisy
# near-zero residual gains are treated as non-improving. The compiled default
# is 100 (eps = 0.1). This ladder widens the dead-zone well past the default:
# Larger eps means more flips are judged non-improving (fewer "improving"
# moves survive the snap), so this probes how aggressive the near-zero-gain
# suppression should be. All other knobs stay at the compiled defaults.
